text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Overdosage of HECTOROL may lead to hypercalcemia, hypercalciuria, and hyperphosphatemia [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) ] . The treatment of acute overdosage should consist of supportive measures and discontinuation of HECTOROL administration. Serum calcium levels should be measured until normal. Based on similarities between doxercalciferol and its active metabolite, 1α,25-(OH) 2 D 2 , it is expected that doxercalciferol is not removed from the blood by dialysis.
